caption:
A smile is charity. Start there today.

The Prophet ﷺ taught that every act of kindness is charity — even meeting your brother with a smiling face, or sharing what is left in your bucket. Kindness doesn't have to be big to count.

— Jami at-Tirmidhi 1970 · Grade: Sahih

Save this as a reminder and share it with someone who needs it today.

#islam #hadith #sunnah #charity #kindness #muslimreminder
alt_text: Jabir bin Abdullah narrated that the Messenger of Allah said:"Every good is charity. Indeed among the good is to meet your brother with a smiling face, and to pour what is left in your bucket into the vessel of your brother — Jami at-Tirmidhi 1970
